fact: The article states that EMIS lacks integration with the Uganda National Examinations Board system, so details of all Senior One and Senior Five students are not yet fully captured, as acknowledged by the Ministry's Assistant Commissioner for Statistics.
The Assistant Commissioner said the ministries and UNEB are working to resolve the EMIS-UNEB integration gap so the affected students can be uploaded.

The article says Primary Leaving Examination results from the National Examination Board have been imported into DHIS2-DEMIS, the decentralised EMIS piloted in 10 of 175 administrative sites, for analysis by district and school.

fact: The brief says examination data (the 2025 Primary Leaving Examination results from the UNEB portal) was integrated into DHIS2-Ed, which also collates the Termly School Report and other datasets, as used by the Makindye Sabagabo municipal education department.

The brief says the DHIS2-Ed system was linked to the Ministry of Health's electronic Integrated Disease Surveillance Reporting (eIDSR) platform so both ministries see school-based surveillance indicators; no date given, so the published date of 2026-04-23 is used.

The APHRC KIX-SEEDS issue brief says Uganda introduced the School Report Card integrated with DHIS2 for Education, and that sustainability depends on system-wide integration, so the link between school-level data and the national platform is not yet national.
system: School Report Card integrated with DHIS2 for Education
